objective: Test whether APNG composition semantics can provide safe replay anchors that reduce retained checkpoint state without weakening pixel correctness or the maximum replay bound.

fullBackground1024At64MiB.interpretation: analytical strict multi-endpoint improvement for the preregistered source-derived scenario only

imageCraftRuntimeCandidate.persistentAnchorRule: full-canvas source blend with disposal != previous establishes the current frame as a persistent start; full-canvas background disposal establishes the next frame as a transparent-canvas persistent start
imageCraftRuntimeCandidate.explicitlyExcludedRule: full-canvas source + previous is not retained as a persistent anchor; subrect background is not a transparent full-canvas reset
imageCraftRuntimeCandidate.testIdentityGate: scripts/check-animation-test-ids.py enforces unique contiguous IMG_ANIM_PT_001-056 and is invoked by ImageCraft scripts/verify.sh

foveaOverlayQualification.boundary: The overlay proves the existing Fovea adapter remains compatible with this ImageCraft candidate under warnings-as-errors; its retained adapter fixtures do not themselves measure semantic-reset memory savings.

claimBoundary.allowed: scoped analytical Pareto statements for the bound semantic-replay scenarios and local runtime correctness/checkpoint-count statements for the bound ImageCraft candidate
claimBoundary.forbidden: universal APNG superiority, released-product claims, encoded-native Fovea startup ranking, physical-device memory/energy/thermal superiority, or cross-library global Pareto dominance

nextGates: publish the exact ImageCraft revision containing the semantic-reset owned APNG runtime and diagnostics
pin that exact revision in Fovea and move the qualified adapter into the compiled production target
capture encoded-native Fovea W5 timing/memory evidence from the production pin
run stable physical iPhone timing, memory, offscreen-work, energy, thermal and reclamation gates
